title: DL2Fence: Integrating Deep Learning and Frame Fusion for Enhanced Detection and Localization of Refined Denial-of-Service in Large-Scale NoCs
problem: Denial-of-Service attacks on Network-on-Chip systems require accurate detection and localization; existing solutions suffer from high hardware overhead and poor scalability to larger mesh NoCs.
motivation: Efficient DoS detection with minimal hardware overhead is critical for securing scalable NoC systems in modern SoCs.
method: DL2Fence employs two specialized Convolutional Neural Networks combined with Frame Fusion: one CNN performs classification-based detection while another performs segmentation-based localization of DoS attacks by analyzing network traffic patterns in mesh NoCs.
key_novelty: Joint use of CNN-based classification and segmentation combined with Frame Fusion for scalable DoS detection and localization with significantly reduced hardware overhead.
contributions: Novel DL2Fence framework combining Deep Learning and Frame Fusion for coupled DoS detection and localization in NoCs
Dual CNN approach achieving 95.8% detection accuracy and 91.7% localization accuracy with 99.3% precision
42.4% reduction in hardware overhead compared to state-of-the-art approaches
limitations: Limitations not discussed in provided abstract.
primary_theme: ML-based DoS detection and localization for Network-on-Chip systems
